definitions.explanation: A region that has suffered damage from a natural disaster — earthquake, typhoon, flood, tsunami, or similar. Standard term in news reports and government statements after major disasters.

examples.japanese: {被災地|ひさいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
{被災地|ひさいち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦{物資|ぶっし}→物資：07863_busshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: Relief supplies arrived in the affected area.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{被災地|ひさいち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{瓦礫|がれき}→瓦礫：30524_gareki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{撤去|てっきょ}→撤去：14729_tekkyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}った→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
examples.english: Student volunteers helped remove rubble in the disaster-stricken area.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{被災|ひさい}→被災：20184_hisai⟧ (suffering a disaster) + {地|ち} (place/region). Used in news, government, and NGO contexts after earthquakes, typhoons, floods, and other large-scale events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {被災地|ひさいち}⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧: support for disaster areas
- {被災地|ひさいち}⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧: disaster-area recovery
- {被災地|ひさいち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{物資|ぶっし}→物資：07863_busshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send supplies to the affected area
- {被災地|ひさいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{視察|しさつ}→視察：16562_shisatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to inspect the disaster area (often of officials)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{被災者|ひさいしゃ}→被災者：25337_hisaisha⟧: disaster victim — the people, not the place
- ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧: disaster region — less standard, more descriptive
- ⟦{避難所|ひなんじょ}→避難所：07374_hinanjo⟧: evacuation shelter — where evacuees stay, often inside or near the {被災地|ひさいち}
